label: Romance
description: Emotionally credible attraction, vulnerability, conflict, and relationship change.
principles: Advance the relationship through choice, vulnerability, trust, desire, or conflict.
Give both characters agency and emotionally credible reasons for resistance.
techniques: Use subtext, attention, physical awareness, and misalignment.
Make external events expose relational needs.
avoid: Possessiveness presented as automatic proof of love
qualityChecks: Is chemistry grounded in these particular characters?
